samples.name: building-drying-rack
samples.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One isolated building sprite for a cozy medieval Slavic village game. The attached Tiny Town and Tiny Farm sheets are STYLE REFERENCES. Match their sparse pixel clusters and clear simplified silhouettes, very limited warm earthy palette, 2-3 flat colors per material, dark local color edges and top-left light. Top-down three-quarter game view: top and south-facing front visible, no isometric diamond, no perspective vanishing points. Strict 32x48 logical pixel canvas, enlarged for output with uniformly square pixels. Transparent background, 1 logical pixel margin. Keep details simple enough for the small native sprite size; no gradients, antialiasing, elaborate texture, soft shadows, text, watermark, additional scenery or characters. Front faces down with doorway at bottom. Subject and required canvas: 32×48 building (footprint 2×2 tiles, poles rise 1 tile above): wooden drying rack of two posts and a crossbar under a small reed roof, strips of red meat, a tan hide and bunches of berries hanging from it.
